cards.claim: Outdoor gatherings are safer than indoor gatherings
cards.paragraph_excerpt: Meet people outside. Outdoor gatherings are safer than indoor ones, particularly if indoor spaces are small and without outdoor air coming in.

cards.claim: Indoor tanning is a safe way to tan
cards.paragraph_excerpt: To lower your skin cancer risk, protect your skin from the sun and avoid tanning.

cards.claim: UV rays from tanning beds can damage skin cells
cards.paragraph_excerpt: Most skin cancers are caused by too much exposure to ultraviolet (UV) rays. UV rays are an invisible kind of radiation that comes from the sun and tanning beds.

cards.claim: Smoking harms nearly every organ of the body
cards.paragraph_excerpt: Smoking harms nearly every organ of the body and causes many diseases.
